svg.title: SDLC in the AI Era with Spec-Driven Development
svg.desc: A full vector infographic outlining guiding principles, the SDLC lifecycle with spec-driven development, supporting flows, capabilities, metrics, governance, and outcomes.

g.text: AI-First • Specification-Centric • Quality by Design • Continuous Value

text.style: font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:9px; fill:#5A2DBB;

g.text: Specification is the Single Source of Truth across the lifecycle
AI copilots for writing specs, code, tests
Generative AI for code, docs, test data
ML for risk prediction & effort estimation
AI for security scanning & threat detection
Definition of Ready (DoR) & Definition of Done (DoD)
PEOPLE + PROCESS + TECHNOLOGY + AI = SUSTAINABLE SOFTWARE EXCELLENCE
